targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, region, energy_kwh FROM cagg_hour_region WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket, region
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', bucket) AS time, SUM(energy_kwh) FROM cagg_15m_region WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w(s) AS (VALUES ('2026-09-01'::date),('2026-09-08'::date),('2026-09-15'::date),('2026-09-22'::date)) SELECT to_char(w.s,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week_start, SUM(c.energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM w LEFT JOIN cagg_15m_region c ON c.bucket >= w.s::timestamptz AND c.bucket < (w.s+7)::timestamptz GROUP BY w.s ORDER BY w.s
SELECT bucket AS time, energy_kwh FROM cagg_day_meter WHERE meter_id = 1000000000 AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY bucket

WITH rc AS (SELECT m.region, COUNT(DISTINCT m.meter_id) AS meters FROM meters m GROUP BY m.region), days AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))/86400 AS n), obs AS (SELECT region, SUM(reading_count) AS n FROM cagg_15m_region WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY region) SELECT rc.region, 100.0 * obs.n / (rc.meters * (SELECT n FROM days) * 96) AS pct FROM rc JOIN obs USING (region) ORDER BY rc.region
